Jordan — thanks for the heads up and the usage snippet. Short answer: yes, we can do a mid-term uplift and resize the Dedicated pool.

High-level options so your CFO/legal can prep:
1) Pro-rata addendum: add +8 GPUs for the remaining 9 months at the committed rate (we pro-rate the monthly invoice) + standard setup uplift fee (one-time) OR
2) Reprice to a larger commit: convert to a renewed larger commit now (40 GPUs) — this requires a 12-month re-commit but unlocks deeper unit discounts and waives the setup uplift.

Discount guidance (draft):
- Option 1 (mid-term add): +8 GPUs at 5% off list (pro-rated). Setup uplift = one-time 2% of the added commit value.
- Option 2 (recommit to 40 GPUs for 12 months): 12% off list on incremental GPUs (applies to whole commit on the new 12-month term).

I’m looping in Monica (solutions) and Marissa (CS/account) to validate throughput impact and operational steps (autoscaler, drain windows, rollout). Would you be open to a short call tomorrow to walk pricing and SLA impact?

Best,
Karthik
